entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: Battle at the end of the Ice Age at a pass in the Karplusan Mountains, later called the Last Battlefield.

entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains north of Krov where the battle took place.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: City south of the battlefield.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: Barbarians led by Lovisa Coldeyes.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Forces of Kjeldor led by General Varchild.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Leader of the Balduvians.

entities.name: General Varchild
entities.description: Leader of the Kjeldorans.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer who led an undead army and was carried off by Leshrac.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage who dueled Lim-Dûl and summoned the Lost Order of Jarkeld.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Taskmage who killed her zombified friend Belenda and unsummoned Chaeska.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Royal mage swarmed by undead and killed.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Warded target of Gustha's spells.

entities.name: Belenda Danisdotter
entities.description: Skyknight turned zombie, killed by Jaya.

entities.name: Lost Order of Jarkeld
entities.description: Order summoned by Jodah.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Keeper of Tresserhorn wielding Márton Stromgald's sword arm.

entities.name: Márton Stromgald
entities.description: Dismantled warrior whose sword arm Chaeska wielded.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Halls to which Chaeska was returned.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who severed Lim-Dûl's hand and planeswalked away with him.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker present behind the opposing side.

entities.name: Mairsil's ring
entities.description: Ring connected to Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Later period during which another battle was called the Battle of Kjeldor.

events.summary: Balduvians and Kjeldorans camp at the pass awaiting Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: The Balduvians led by Lovisa Coldeyes and the Kjeldorans led by General Varchild set up camp there

events.summary: Gustha Ebbasdotter is swarmed by undead and falls.
events.quote: Gustha Ebbasdotter was swarmed by piles of undead

events.summary: Jaya kills her zombified friend Belenda Danisdotter.
events.quote: After hesitating, Jaya managed to kill Belenda.

events.summary: Jodah summons the Lost Order of Jarkeld to protect Lovisa Coldeyes.
events.quote: Jodah summoned the Lost Order of Jarkeld to join the battle

events.summary: Jaya casts Unsummon on Chaeska, returning him to Tresserhorn.
events.quote: she used blue mana and cast Unsummon on him

events.summary: Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, who summons Leshrac; Leshrac severs Lim-Dûl's hand and planeswalks away with him.
events.quote: Leshrac then severed Lim-Dûl's hand, tearing his connection with Mairsil 's ring, and planeswalked away

events.summary: The site becomes known as the Last Battlefield, the last battle of the Ice Age.
events.quote: this particular battle was the last one fought during the Ice Age

relations.quote: The Balduvians led by Lovisa Coldeyes
the Kjeldorans led by General Varchild

relations.note: Killed her former friend turned zombie.
relations.quote: After hesitating, Jaya managed to kill Belenda.

relations.note: Summoned by Lim-Dûl but left, taking him along.
relations.quote: Lim-Dûl summoned Leshrac to aid him
